gloss: to replenish; to refill; to restock; to supplement

definitions.gloss: to replenish; to refill; to restock; to supplement
definitions.explanation: to replenish; to refill; to restock; to supplement

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}を{補充|ほじゅう}する。
{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}の{飲|の}み{物|もの}を{補充|ほじゅう}した。
examples.english: I restocked the drinks in the vending machine.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}に{必要|ひつよう}な{水分|すいぶん}をこまめに{補充|ほじゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please replenish the fluids your body needs at regular intervals.

examples.japanese: {退職者|たいしょくしゃ}の{分|ぶん}の{人員|じんいん}を{補充|ほじゅう}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to fill the positions left by employees who resigned.

notes:
Refers to adding to something that has been depleted or is insufficient to bring it back to the required level. Used for physical supplies (stock, fluids, fuel) as well as abstract resources (personnel, knowledge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在庫|ざいこ}を{補充|ほじゅう}する: restock inventory
- {人員|じんいん}を{補充|ほじゅう}する: fill personnel vacancies
- {水分|すいぶん}を{補充|ほじゅう}する: replenish fluids
- {補充|ほじゅう}{要員|よういん}: replacement personnel
- {補充|ほじゅう}{品|ひん}: refill; replacement product

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {補給|ほきゅう}する: to supply; to resupply — often used in military or logistics contexts for supplying provisions, fuel, or ammunition
- {補|おぎな}う: to make up for; to compensate — a broader term that covers compensating for a deficiency, not just restocking
- {追加|ついか}する: to add — simply adding more of something, without the nuance of restoring a depleted supply
